body:
Quick pass (coordinator, read only, no build) on head `14d718ffe`: the PR is a sub-PR of `side/path-kernel` and merges cleanly with it (`7cd322966`). It changes only files of the law suite (`crates/pathkernel/tests/laws/`) and one decision file. The author's checks are green on this head: `cargo check --tests` for pathkernel, the `laws` suite (173 passed), clippy, and the quick gate against the side branch. The writer record on #4406 is released. The body starts with `Side branch: side/path-kernel` and has `Refs #4406` and `Refs #4383`. The PR is flagged ready. It waits for the independent review.

Notes for the reviewer. This PR closes class A of the review of PR #4383 (head `7cd322966`): each law assertion can break, and a refusal is never held.
- Check the proof: for each law, a stand-in that breaks it is caught, and `no_law_is_held_on_an_always_refusing_planner_set` shows that no law is held when each stage refuses.
- The new rule found three hollow passes: the medial planner, the circle rings and the helix planner held L2 only from a refusal (their fixture had no stock). The author gave the fixture a stock box; the check and the kernel source did not change. Check that this is a fix of the fixture and not a weaker check.
- One pin moved: the L6 breaker reads 0.711 against the cap 0.625 (before: 0.9 or more), because the stand-in helix is now a real turn. Check that the pin still proves a break.
- L7 now reads recorded files (`tests/laws/records/`). The author checked the square record by hand; the island record was recorded from the stand-ins and not checked by hand.
- PR #4328 (the 2D Pocket recipe) registers the first moved kind and is not on this base. After it merges, `each_moved_kind_obeys_every_law` runs a real case with the new verdicts.

Merge into `side/path-kernel` (coordinator of NeoTech): the head merges cleanly with the side branch at `7cd322966`. The merge relies on the clean review of 2026-11-27T19:03:45Z on head `14d718ffe` by the review session camcraft-61 (a separate session from the author's worker, same GitHub account). The writer record is released, and no reviewer record is active. Maintainer order (question dialog, 2026-11-26): this session merges reviewed sub-PRs of `side/path-kernel`. This merge moves the head of PR #4383.
